summary.business_type: Local service – vehicle rental (service-area business, Siliguri)
top_findings: Unverified 4.8 rating / 500+ riders stats with no reviews on site
Templated destination pages with ~250 unique words each
Incomplete local business details (address, hours, geo, GBP)
Social links are # placeholders; sameAs empty
quick_wins: Fill in real social URLs in includes/config.php
Add address, geo, openingHours, priceRange to AutoRental schema
Replace placeholder bike photos with real fleet photos
Show starting prices on bikes page

findings.title: No security headers; X-Powered-By exposed
findings.description: Responses lack HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options and expose PHP version.
findings.recommendation: Add mod_headers rules in .htaccess and unset X-Powered-By.

findings.title: Cache headers unverified
findings.description: mod_expires not active locally; no Cache-Control on images.
findings.recommendation: Verify on live host after deployment.

findings.title: robots.txt per-bot groups override Disallow
findings.description: Googlebot/Bingbot groups only Allow /, so /_build/ Disallow under * does not apply to them.
findings.recommendation: Remove per-bot groups or repeat Disallow.

findings.title: Unverified rating and rider stats
findings.description: STATS shows 4.8 rating and 500+ riders with no reviews or source on the site.
findings.recommendation: Add real testimonials or link Google reviews; remove the rating until backed.

findings.title: No pricing
findings.recommendation: Publish starting prices per day/week per bike.

findings.title: Thin templated destination pages
findings.description: 9 destination pages share one template with ~250 unique words each.
findings.recommendation: Add 150-300 unique words and own photos per destination.

findings.title: Weak authorship / about info
findings.description: No owner name, experience or shop location.
findings.recommendation: Expand About page with people and location.

findings.title: Stock photos only
findings.description: All images are Unsplash, including placeholder bike photos.
findings.recommendation: Use real fleet and ride photos.

findings.title: Short guides
findings.recommendation: Expand to 800+ words and add more guides.

findings.title: Meta description lengths
findings.description: Home 189, destinations 182, several destination pages 179-183; guides 71-83.

findings.title: Incomplete LocalBusiness data
findings.description: No streetAddress, postalCode, geo, openingHoursSpecification, priceRange, hasMap.

findings.title: Empty sameAs
findings.recommendation: Add real profile URLs and GBP URL.

findings.title: No responsive or modern-format hero images
findings.description: 1600px JPG heroes of 180-190 KB served to all devices.

findings.title: Few off-site brand signals
findings.description: No linked social profiles or listings.
findings.recommendation: Create GBP, directory listings, social content.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive alt text on all images

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF or srcset
findings.recommendation: Add modern formats and responsive sizes.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Back up or remove rating stats
Complete LocalBusiness schema and contact address
